About.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a Fullstack / Product Developer with a technical background and an engineering education, complemented by a professional qualification in Fullstack development.
I work on my own products as well as commercial projects for clients — from the initial idea and architecture through to running them in production.
I'm based in Berlin and build with modern technologies across web, automation and AI integrations.

Projects.headline: Products with real substance
Projects.description: My own products and client solutions – conceived, built and supported all the way into production.

descriptions.dev2lab: A developer and client platform for matching, jobs, offers and IT collaboration — built end to end as a personal SaaS product.
descriptions.italiano-daily: A Telegram bot for daily Italian practice with lessons, quizzes, streaks and AI-powered fallback.
descriptions.olidort-bedachungen: A conversion-focused commercial website with a service calculator, analytics tracking and SEO, built for a real client.
descriptions.space-burger: A visually driven brand website with custom animations and a fully responsive frontend build.

Checkliste.title: Project Checklist
Checkliste.subtitle: So the quote actually fits your project
Checkliste.description: Check off what you need. Takes about 5 minutes.
Checkliste.disclaimer: This checklist contains no prices and is not a contract. It's only meant to clarify project scope.

goals.title: What do you want to build?

errors.required: Please select at least one option.

newWebsite.label: New website
newWebsite.description: A company website, landing page, or online business card

websiteRelaunch.label: Redesign an existing website
websiteRelaunch.description: Modernize the tech, design, and mobile experience

telegramBot.label: Telegram bot
telegramBot.description: Handle inquiries, bookings, or workflows right inside the messenger

webApp.label: Web app / portal
webApp.description: A custom application with login, database, and an admin area

scope.title: Website · Scope
scope.description: A section is a content block on the page, e.g. "About us" or "Services".

block-hero-startbereich.label: Eye-catching hero section
block-hero-startbereich.description: Large image or video, key message, call to action

block-services-overview.label: Services overview
block-services-overview.description: What you offer, as cards or a list

block-team.label: Team
block-team.description: Team members with photo and role

feature-contact-form.label: Contact form
feature-contact-form.description: Inquiries land in your inbox by email

feature-multistep-form.label: Multi-step inquiry form
feature-multistep-form.description: Asks step by step instead of all at once

feature-file-upload.label: File upload in the form
feature-file-upload.description: Clients can upload photos or plans

feature-telegram-notification.label: Instant Telegram notification
feature-telegram-notification.description: Every inquiry arrives as a message on your phone

visibility.title: Visibility, Legal & Analytics
visibility.description: I recommend the first three almost always.

seo-technical.label: Technical search engine optimization
seo-technical.description: So Google can read and rank the site cleanly

seo-structured-data.label: Structured business data
seo-structured-data.description: Opening hours, address, and services made machine-readable

legal-cookie-banner.label: Cookie banner and consent
legal-cookie-banner.description: Required as soon as analytics or ads are in use

analytics-setup.label: Set up visitor analytics
analytics-setup.description: Google Analytics plus groundwork for ad campaigns

google-business-profile.label: Set up Google Business Profile
google-business-profile.description: Your listing in Google Search and Maps

accessibility-full.label: Full accessibility implementation
accessibility-full.description: For offers covered by the German Accessibility Strengthening Act

bot-setup.label: Set up the bot
bot-setup.description: Foundation, commands, hosting — the basis for everything else

bot-guided-dialog.label: Guided dialog with buttons
bot-guided-dialog.description: The bot asks questions, the user taps to answer

bot-data-storage.label: Persistent data storage
bot-data-storage.description: Users, requests, and states are kept

bot-booking.label: Book appointments in the bot
bot-booking.description: Show open slots, book, send reminders

bot-mini-app.label: Full interface inside the bot
bot-mini-app.description: A small app that runs inside Telegram

bot-hosting.label: Ongoing bot operation
bot-hosting.description: Monthly — a bot has to run somewhere permanently

autoMessageCount.label: Automated messages
autoMessageCount.description: Scheduled or triggered by specific events

webapp.title: Web app / Portal
webapp.description: This always starts with a paid concept phase. Only after that can binding prices be given — anything else would be guesswork.

webapp-notifications.label: Notifications to users
webapp-notifications.description: By email or inside the app

webapp-data-migration.label: Data migration from an old system

existing.title: What do you already have?
existing.description: The most important section. Missing content is the most common reason projects get more expensive and take longer. "No" is completely fine — it just gets planned in.

texts.label: Finished copy for all pages
texts.description: Written and approved, not just an idea

photos.label: Own photos in good quality
photos.description: From the business, the work, the team

logoVector.label: Logo as a vector file
logoVector.description: SVG, AI, or EPS — not just a photo or JPG

legalDocs.label: Legal notice and privacy policy
legalDocs.description: From a lawyer or a vetted generator

domain.label: Domain in place
domain.description: The web address the site will run on

businessEmail.label: Business email address
businessEmail.description: info@yourcompany.com instead of a free-mail address

googleProfile.label: Google Business Profile
googleProfile.description: The listing on Google Maps and in Search

support.title: After launch
support.description: A website isn't a piece of furniture — tech and security updates keep going. Without ongoing care, everything stays frozen at handover-day state.

support-full.label: Monthly care
support-full.description: Updates, backups, monitoring, and time for small changes

support-small.label: Monthly care, small
support-small.description: Just updates, backups, and an uptime check

support-biannual-check.label: Maintenance twice a year
support-biannual-check.description: A batched check instead of monthly care

contact.description: So I can reach out about anything still open.
